what: performance_budget r4 — full-budget certification at BOTH dprs + the three majors from the r3 verdict fixed for real. Fixes to non-owned files are packaged as docs/handoff/performance_budget-r3.patch (git apply from repo root; verified with --check against commit 2ed0fed) + docs/handoff/performance_budget-r3.md. Owned changes (tools/perfprobe.mjs) are already applied: gates FROZEN (7M tris, texture gate ratcheted 896 -> 512 MB as promised once eviction landed), ratchet-warning lines, os.loadavg() certification guard, warmup GC before the sampled window. Reproduce: node tools/perfprobe.mjs --dsf 1|2 (after applying the patch).

fixes.loadToReady_major: spawnTanks built ALL 17 pool vehicles at boot (~250-350 ms of 2048^2 canvas bakes each — boot CPU profile: applyGrain alone 2.33 s). Now lazy: entities carry visual:null, only the staged core-8 build at boot; setupBattle builds picked participants on entry (inside the garage->battle transition). Measured: 8386-8809 ms -> 6667-7165 ms across 5 quiet-window runs at both dprs.
frameMsP99_major: GLB pipeline made battle-safe (modelLoader.js): fetch immediately, but GLTFLoader.parse AND the swap run through an idle queue that never executes while game.phase==='battle', one job per slot, jobs spaced 300 ms (a naive drain measured a 4.3 s frozen frame at battle end), textures initTexture'd + programs compiled in the same slot. Renderer counters now FLAT across battle (textures 123, geometries 248; live tree climbed to 200/344).

Garage spot lights hidden during battle (main.js): two 60 m spots 1500 m from the battlefield were adding spot-light uniform traffic (uniform3f 3.8 s of a 35 s battle profile) + fragment cost to EVERY battle draw. Light-count shader variants pre-compiled at boot (no mid-battle compile storm). Single biggest p99 lever: dsf1 p99 25.9 -> 15.4 ms.
fx flipbook/atlas textures pre-uploaded at boot (they used to upload inside the first-contact combat frame).
fixes.sceneTextureMB_major: setupBattle EVICTS parked vehicles' visuals (scene remove + dispose; materials.js texture cache is refcounted). 716.8 MB -> 294.5 MB measured; perfprobe gate ratcheted to the promised 512 MB and passes with 43% headroom.
fixes.gateRatchet_minor: trianglesMedianMax 7M and sceneTextureMBMax FROZEN with a no-raise-without-signoff note; 6M triangle ratchet target printed as a RATCHET WARN delta every run.
fixes.contention_minor: perfprobe stamps os.loadavg() (report.machine {cores, load1Start, load1End, contended}); certification REFUSED and the trend row flagged note:'contended' when ambient 1-min load > 0.5x cores (or a mid-run spike beyond the probe's own ~5-load footprint). Verified live: contended runs print the refusal and tag their rows.
fixes.heapThinMargin_minor: 180 s soak with per-10 s heap floors + renderer.info: geometries/textures/programs PERFECTLY flat 264/120/70 from t=30 s to t=180 s across 4 accumulated wrecks; heap floor 239.3 -> 232.7 MB (-0.055 MB/s). The old +0.78-0.81 readings were mid-battle GLB binds + GC phase, not a leak. Probe now also runs a warmup GC (--js-flags=--expose-gc) after battle entry so the certification window measures sustained combat, not the boot bake's one-shot large-object reclamation; the heap gate still watches the full 60 s and starts from a STRICTER post-GC floor.

certification.note: Patched worktree of commit 2ed0fed (isolated from sibling-agent edits), quiet windows on a live developer desktop (ambient load1 5.3-7.2/18 cores; probe stamps every run). Screenshot harness green on the same tree — 14/14 views, zero console errors, GLB Abrams verified in garage/closeups/player_view, burnt wreck + killcam verified.

dsf2.repeats: two additional full passes at dsf2 on the final code: p99 16.0 (load 6710) and 19.6 (load 6729); one pre-fx-warm run measured 26.2 — the fx first-upload warm closed it

certification.variance: p99 at dsf2 swings ~6 ms run-to-run with desktop ambient (WindowServer/Chrome/IDE own ~3-4 cores + GPU compositing). All finals pass with margin; contended runs are self-flagging now.

boot.profileBefore: 8.4-8.8 s: applyGrain 2.33 s + materials.js total 2.56 s (17 vehicle bakes), SimplexNoise 1.92 s + terrain.js 1.57 s (createMap verdant), sky 0.28 s, sourcedTextures 0.18 s
boot.after: 6.7-7.2 s at both dprs (5 runs). Remaining block is createMap('verdant') terrain/noise (~3.5 s) — content_terrain follow-up filed in the handoff if the 4.2 s baseline is ever wanted back; the 8 s gate now holds with ~1 s headroom.
boot.tradeoff: first RANDOM battle with community vehicles builds their visuals inside the garage->battle transition (~0.2-0.3 s each) and shows procedural stand-ins until the end screen/garage applies the queued GLB swaps — deliberate: a AAA frame gate never trades combat frames for asset upgrades.
